title: QuickBooks Online and the Customer Invoice report show the same line text
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QuickBooks host (for example qb1.qa.shopview.com).
  • The shop has an active QuickBooks Online connection to sandbox company {Sandbox-company-A} (for example ShopView QA Sandbox), and you can sign in to that sandbox.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154715 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154715 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "Replace tie rod"), Description (for example "excessive play") and the tech story (for example "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • {Work-order-1} was completed and invoiced while the connection was active, as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to QuickBooks Online and open sandbox company {Sandbox-company-A}.
  2. Open the invoice for {Customer-A} that matches {Invoice-A}.
  3. Read {Line-1}'s Description in that invoice.
  4. In ShopView, open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  5. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  6. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  7. Download the report.
  8. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  9. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  10. Compare the text from step 3 with the text from step 9, character by character.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the invoice is in QuickBooks Online.
  • Step 3: the Description reads exactly the title, the description and the tech story joined by " - " (with the example values "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • Step 9: the ItemDescription cell reads the same words.
  • Step 10: the two texts are identical, character for character.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R4, S3-R1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-010; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R4: “The same text is used by the live QuickBooks sync and by the downloadable Customer Invoice report. The two can never show different text for the same line.”
  • S3-R1: “A line's text joins the title, the description and the technician's narrative with a spaced hyphen and no labels: "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given the same invoice is both synced and downloaded as the Customer Invoice report, then the line text is identical in both.”
  • Tech plan FR-010: “One builder produces the text for both the live QuickBooks Online sync and the downloadable Customer Invoice report; nothing else reads it (S3-R4, S3-R11).”
